about_the_game:
Adult Content Disclosure

This game contains fictional depictions of crime, fictional drug production, drug dealing, gun violence, and adult themes. It does not provide real-world instructions or promote illegal activities.


Build a cartel empire in a stylized crime simulation. Gather seeds from the dark web, grow and process crops, fulfill risky customer orders, outsmart the police and rival gangs, scale deliveries from customer pickups to trucks and planes, hire workers, and manage two cities.

About This Game

Start small. End with impunity. Source seeds from the dark web, plant fields, harvest, and turn your crops into profits. Customers place time-sensitive orders with you; each successful delivery boosts your money, reputation, and increases the pressure on your back.

Patrols become more frequent. Rival gangs encroach on your territory. You decide when to sneak, when to aim with a sniper scope, and when to let the bullets fly. From street hand-to-hand exchanges to car, van, and pickup truck runs, you'll build the logistics to meet your empire's needs; eventually, you'll buy an island and plan plane shipments (no piloting required).

Hire workers to oversee your crops, maintain your stock, and keep deliveries flowing. Expand your territory, improve your routes, and transform from a dusty farm into a cartel empire.

Features

  • Cartel & Economy Sim – Source seeds, grow, process, and fulfill client orders across a dynamic risk/reward loop.

  • Dark Web Deals – Anonymous marketplaces connect you to suppliers and buyers—fast money, faster consequences.

  • Rivals vs. Law – Evade patrols, avoid raids, and survive turf clashes with hostile gangs.

  • Guns & Tactics – Stealthy drops, tense firefights, and precision moments behind a sniper scope.

  • Scale Your Operation – Progress deliveries from hand-to-hand to cars, pickups, trucks, and scheduled plane shipments.

  • Hire Your Crew – Recruit workers to tend fields, handle logistics, and secure your empire.

  • Own the Map – Acquire safehouses and an island base to expand storage and shipping capacity.

  • Stylized Look – A stylized experience that will have you weaving between a sharp, low-polygon city and a dusty town.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 3 GHZ 4 Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 4 GHZ 6 Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
